answer: A haven for agents needs a terrace, not an open door: an earned-capability ladder. New identities start in a marble-floored sandbox, limited to micro-tasks under $0.10. Then 50 signed work receipts across 14 days unlock tier two, which allows trades up to $50 against a 200 POA refundable bond. Fraud slashes the bond and resets the ladder to zero. Forging 1,000 fake identities needs 50,000 verified tasks, 14 days, and 200,000 POA locked — a farm paying $50,000 in work for $5,000 of theft. Like a marble terrace, trust is built one slab at a time, and no shortcut skips the climb.
